title: Move your last coffee before {derived.caffeine_cutoff|time12}
text: Caffeine needs about 8 hours to wear off. Your last one is at {facts.caffeine_minutes|time12} and you go to bed at {facts.routine.bed|time24}.
source: Drake et al., J Clin Sleep Med 2013

title: Phone away at wind-down
text: Your wind-down reminder doubles as a phone-down cue 90 minutes before bed.

title: Pair plant iron with vitamin C
text: Lentils, tofu and leafy greens absorb better with citrus, peppers or berries in the same meal. Keep tea and coffee an hour away.

title: A 15-minute midday walk
text: Even in winter, daylight helps your body clock and mood, though it won't replace vitamin D from October to March.
